title: Mayor Gloria Signs Law that Improves College Area Community Plan
description: SAN DIEGO – Mayor Todd Gloria is joined by San Diego City Councilmember Sean Elo-Rivera and others as he signs into law the ordinance that updates the College Community Plan, which was given final approval by the City Council last week. The updated plan furthers the Mayor’s goal of building more housing in all communities and improving quality of life for all San Diegans.
